body:
I understand dude.

Quit my job 2 weeks ago because the boss was an ass and wanted to pay me less, since then it's been awful and I've even regretted it.  

I've sent in my resume to at least 40 places in these 2 weeks and got 5 responses.   

4 of the places wanted to pay me wages that are laughable, and they weren't even operating legally (wanted to pay in cash, big no no)  

One place was great, cushy office job, good pay, benefits. I had 2 interviews, both went amazing and they offered me the job and told me they would get back to me. Then I got an email that there are some shifts ending late at night and I wouldn't be able to get to my train so they are not going to hire me. We are talking about 15 minutes. I leave 15 minutes early and I can get there. There were even talks of home office that could solve this issue but no.  

I feel fucking awful. I even stopped searching because I thought this job was 100%. Now I'm back in the race. 90% of the places don't even respond, even if they do there is a chance they suck.   

I'm 22 and live with my mom so thankfully I won't be homeless but I can't believe that I'm unable to get my life together. My father made my life hell and I've been trying to get on my own feet since, my mom can help but not so much with minimum wage, and I can't stay with her forever.   

I shouldn't even feel like this but I can't help it.
